tagline: Emerging Market Entrepreneur building tech solutions with limited capital
description: A builder in a high-growth region like Kenya or Brazil using AI to bypass the local shortage of affordable engineering talent.
rationale: Brand perception data shows Kenya leads the user base at 12.78%, with high traffic from India and Brazil, indicating a massive global adoption trend.
Arjun faces extreme capital constraints and currency fluctuations (e.g., the Brazilian user complaint about costs); Lovable democratizes access to high-end software architecture.
Strategically, this persona represents the 'addressable volume' play; capturing this market ensures Lovable becomes the global standard for the '99% of humanity' who cannot code.
